apply.heading: 生活應用
apply.note: 8 則磁鐵生活應用，點按卡片觀看動畫示意（.is-on 觸發 .anim 移動）。

cases.title: 指南針
cases.caption: 指南針裡是一根會轉的小磁針，它會自動指向南北方，幫我們找方向。
cases.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 60'><circle cx='60' cy='30' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#9aa7b4' stroke-width='3'/><g class='anim'><polygon points='60,10 64,30 60,34 56,30' fill='#e63946'/><polygon points='60,50 64,30 60,26 56,30' fill='#1d6fb8'/></g><text x='60' y='8' font-size='7' text-anchor='middle' fill='#5d6770'>N</text></svg>

cases.title: 冰箱磁貼
cases.caption: 磁鐵能吸住冰箱的鐵門，所以可以用磁貼把紙條、照片貼上去。
cases.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 60'><rect x='80' y='4' width='34' height='52' rx='3' fill='#e9edf2' stroke='#b9c3cd' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='84' y1='8' x2='84' y2='52' stroke='#cfd8e0' stroke-width='2'/><rect class='anim' x='8' y='22' width='22' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e63946'/></svg>

cases.title: 磁鐵門扣
cases.caption: 櫃子門上的小磁扣，靠磁力把門吸住，輕輕一拉又能打開。
cases.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 60'><rect x='88' y='4' width='8' height='52' fill='#8d6e63'/><rect x='82' y='25' width='6' height='10' rx='1' fill='#1d6fb8'/><g class='anim'><rect x='8' y='6' width='56' height='48' rx='3' fill='#c9a36b'/><rect x='64' y='26' width='6' height='8' fill='#90a4ae'/></g></svg>

cases.title: 磁浮列車
cases.caption: 用同極相斥的磁力，把列車「浮」起來，幾乎沒有摩擦，可以跑得超快。
cases.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 60'><rect x='6' y='50' width='108' height='6' fill='#9aa7b4'/><rect class='anim' x='20' y='30' width='80' height='18' rx='9' fill='#1d6fb8'/></svg>

cases.title: 磁鐵釣魚玩具
cases.caption: 釣竿前端是磁鐵，小魚身上有鐵片，磁力一吸就把魚「釣」起來。
cases.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 60'><line x1='30' y1='6' x2='60' y2='28' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='56' y='26' width='10' height='6' fill='#e63946'/><g class='anim'><ellipse cx='60' cy='44' rx='12' ry='7' fill='#f4a259'/><polygon points='72,44 82,38 82,50' fill='#f4a259'/></g></svg>

cases.title: 喇叭（揚聲器）
cases.caption: 喇叭裡有磁鐵和線圈，靠磁力推動紙盆振動，就發出聲音了。
cases.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 60'><rect x='10' y='18' width='16' height='24' fill='#1d6fb8'/><polygon points='26,14 50,4 50,56 26,46' fill='#c9a36b'/><g class='anim'><path d='M62,18 Q72,30 62,42' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='3'/><path d='M74,12 Q90,30 74,48' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='3'/></g></svg>

cases.title: 磁性白板與磁釦
cases.caption: 白板是鐵做的，用磁釦就能把海報、作品吸在上面，不用膠帶。
cases.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 60'><rect x='6' y='6' width='108' height='48' rx='3' fill='#f4f7fb' stroke='#b9c3cd' stroke-width='2'/><circle class='anim' cx='30' cy='30' r='8' fill='#e63946'/></svg>

cases.title: 回收場的大磁鐵
cases.caption: 回收場用超大電磁鐵吸起鐵罐和廢鐵，把鐵和其他垃圾分開來。
cases.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 60'><rect x='44' y='4' width='32' height='12' rx='2' fill='#444'/><rect x='50' y='16' width='20' height='8' fill='#e63946'/><g class='anim'><rect x='52' y='34' width='10' height='14' rx='2' fill='#9aa7b4'/><rect x='66' y='36' width='10' height='14' rx='2' fill='#9aa7b4'/></g></svg>
